semiconductor_relevance: Medium — CECA facilitates collaboration and connects members with specialized suppliers in the semiconductor sector.
summary: The China Electronics Chamber of Commerce (CECA) facilitates collaboration within the semiconductor value chain by connecting its members with designated suppliers offering specialized products and services. Through its initiatives, CECA enhances the visibility of cutting-edge semiconductor technologies and supports a robust ecosystem for manufacturers and service providers.
capabilities: Facilitating collaboration among electronics and information industry members
Connecting members with designated suppliers for specialized semiconductor products and services
Promoting new and refined semiconductor products
